note: Jones County (IA) zoning districts are published only through the Schneider Beacon 'Real Estate Mapping' viewer (Zoning District layer) and a static 2021 PDF zoning map. No public ArcGIS REST service for county zoning was found in the county GIS pages or ArcGIS search. The only ArcGIS-hosted Iowa zoning copy found (ISU zoning_districts_all_data_v2) is an academic digitization covering only Anamosa and Monticello, not the unincorporated county where the sample point lies, and is not official. Anamosa and Monticello publish zoning as PDF/static maps only.
